image.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium editorial cover for a Persian AI infrastructure essay, landscape 16:9, high-resolution 2048x1152.
Primary request: Visualize “a second computing platform does not have to be built from scratch”: reuse of open-source engineering components lowers migration work, while testing and production engineering still remain.
Scene and composition: a sophisticated cinematic architectural cutaway inside a dark modern data center. Two physically separate glowing infrastructure routes cross a deep dark service trench toward the same luminous abstract model/service cube in the far middle. A mature green route on one side originates at a discreet NVIDIA server rack. On the other side a striking cyan route from an Ascend server rack is being assembled from reusable precision-machined modular bridge segments. Several completed cyan segments have clean small labels “DeepInfer”, “TorchNPU”, “HCCL”. An adjacent open equipment case contains matching ready-made modules, clearly showing reuse rather than construction from raw material. Most of the second route is built, with one final short amber-outlined segment still to be integrated before the service destination; convey engineering and validation remaining, not plug-and-play equivalence. Emphasize the second route in the foreground; both platforms remain useful. Architectural realism, brushed metal, fine luminous circuits, volumetric depth, restrained cyan/teal and emerald lighting, warm amber validation accents, polished photorealistic 3D editorial illustration, excellent materials, strong focal hierarchy and generous negative space across the upper quarter.
Text: one large professionally typeset Persian headline at top, exactly “مسیر دوم، از صفر شروع نمی‌شود”. Small secondary line beneath it, exactly “DeepInfer و هزینهٔ خروج از وابستگی”. Optional tiny bottom-right “ZIABARY.IR”.
Constraints: Persian right-to-left glyphs must be correctly joined and spelled. No other slogans, no benchmark charts, no speed or performance numbers, no claims of parity, no politicians, no national maps or flags, no humans, no robots, no visual clutter. Do not imply DeepInfer alone supplies a full production service. Make it editorially compelling and elegant, not a crowded infographic.
image.review: Persian headline and subtitle checked; reusable modules and two infrastructure paths shown. No numerical benchmark or claim of performance parity.
